newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso falls as centback backs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso falls as centback backs dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso fell 0.35 to 1,000.41 pesos to the dollar as the central bank stepped in to prop up the greenback, interbank traders said.

"The central bank stepped in and bought $20 million to support the dollar," one trader said. The trader said that, including Tuesday's intervention in the market, the central bank had spent $420 million in propping up the under-pressure greenback in December alone. The central bank has declined to comment on its operations.
Dealers reported total trades of $131.5 million. The peso value varied just 0.4 pesos throughout the session.
